basis.governing_question: How can Metalúrgica Norte cut conversion cost across its six plants in Portugal and Spain and put the improvements in place in every plant?

sub_questions.question: Where does conversion cost per part arise in each of the six plants, and how large is each loss?
Which improvements can lower conversion cost per part by a measurable amount in every plant?
Do the changes at the pilot site lower conversion cost per part in the cost data?
How do the improvements get running in all six plants, wave by wave?
Is conversion cost per part down by a measurable amount in each plant against its baseline?

drivers.evidence: across its six plants in Portugal and Spain

work.unit: Site diagnosed on the floor (cost baseline, line observation, loss analysis)

phase_work.why: Three representative sites in two rounds, two at once; the rest extended from data. Max exceeds typical 3-6 weeks because of the second round.

work.unit: Pilot site: changes made and savings shown in the cost data
Rollout wave of up to 3 sites

phase_work.why: Pilot site first, then two rollout waves of up to 3 sites, in sequence. Above typical 8-16 weeks because all six plants are covered.

sizing.levers: Running the two rollout waves side by side would save 4-6 weeks; diagnosing two sites instead of three would save one 2-3 week round.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish the conversion cost per part baseline at representative plants and size the improvement opportunities for all six.

gate.label: Initiatives go/no-go
gate.decision: Go or no-go on implementing the sized initiatives, starting at the pilot site?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Implement the approved improvements at a pilot plant, then roll them out to all six plants.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the final result, with improvements running in all six plants?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given: the 25-29 weeks total is an estimate from the sizing and must be settled before this becomes a quote.
Implementation takes the 19-21 weeks around the middle of a 16-24 estimate; it reaches the top if the pilot site and both waves run long.
No Measurement phase: results tracking runs inside Implementation; confirm whether tracking after the last wave, against the success criteria, is expected.
